notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR21: the status key "indicates the status condition of the previously executed SEND, PURGE, ENABLE OUTPUT, or DISABLE OUTPUT statement" per Table 1 (§1985:XIV.2.2.5). Every statement runs through MessageControlSession.Statement, which writes the action's status with CommunicationArea.SetStatus into positions 9-10 and the emitter stores the image back. Probes at 85 gave the table's values for each statement: 00, 10 (disabled), 15 (already enabled), 20, 30, 40 (bad key), 50, 60, 65 (capacity), 70 (PURGE with no portion), 80 (unknown + disabled), and 91 for unreadable definitions; the witness checks 30 for a zero count.

next.reason: 1985: "The content of the data item referenced by data-name-3, indicates the status condition of the previously executed SEND"; 2023: "No communication description entry in 2023; the communication module and the SEND/PURGE/ENABLE statements are not in the candidates". The 1985 CD entry's status key belongs to the Communication module. No 2023 candidate covers communication descriptions, so the feature is dropped.
